dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Windblume Festival and adventurers...

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: A lot of couples will choose to have dates at Cape Oath, but there are some brave adventurer couples who will venture near Stormterror's Lair.

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: That area is simply crawling with monsters, so many adventurers will come here to purchase new equipment...

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: ...After all, if you were to be beaten by monsters in that place, you wouldn't just lose face — you'd be putting your companion in danger, too...

dialogues.speaker: Schulz
dialogues.text: So each time the Windblume Festival rolls around, we smiths run brisker business than usual, so I suppose we can be thankful for that.
